evidence.quote: This process uses [Mongosync](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongosync/current/) as the underlying data migration tool, enabling faster live migrations with less downtime:
Atlas syncs data from the source to the destination cluster until you cut your applications over to the destination Atlas cluster.

The Atlas Live Migration Service initiates an initial copy of the data from the source database (only MongoDB databases), monitors for any subsequent changes, and ensures synchronization until it's time to cut over to MongoDB Atlas.
Throughout this process, applications can maintain their normal read and write operations on the source database.

evidence.quote: Stop your application instances, point them to the Atlas cluster, and restart them.
Stop writes to the source cluster.
When you're ready to perform the cutover, the connection string in the application is updated from the source database to the Atlas cluster, which completes the migration.
